object.description: Delete a leaf object that has an outgoing link; delete an object that has a figure; delete a parent object's only sub-object. Expected: the object file, links file and figure are gone; the object is no longer in the outline, and its parent's outline entry is left empty. (A figure that is a link to a file elsewhere makes the document a load error: MELLON-STORE-SRS-229.)
